notes: ACCESS: www.grandinroad.com returns HTTP 403 (Akamai plus Cloudflare) on a plain fetch and r.jina.ai is served a Cloudflare 'Just a moment...' challenge (403). curl_cffi with impersonate=chrome124 was served 200 on the FIRST profile tried and carried every request in the run (robots.txt, sitemaps, nav API, all UnbxdAPI grid calls, ~60 requests, no rotation needed). No browser automation used. ROBOTS: robots.txt was fetched and read in full - there is NO Claude-specific disallow (no ClaudeBot / Claude-User / Claude-SearchBot / Claude-Web entry); User-agent: * disallows only checkout, account, search, session and a handful of merchandising paths, and the JSON nav API line is commented out ('#Disallow: /*JSONAPIs'), i.e. permitted. /UnbxdAPI is not disallowed. PLATFORM AND CORPORATE-SIBLING CHECK: Grandin Road runs the same Cornerstone Brands stack as S.N. 37 Frontgate (c37.json) and S.N. 36 Ballard Designs (c36.json) - IBM WebSphere Commerce with a React PWA storefront (/wcsstore/CornerStoneBrands/, PWAFramework.js) and an Unbxd search layer behind the site's own same-origin /UnbxdAPI proxy controller. This is a SHARED PLATFORM, NOT A DUPLICATE COMPANY, verified rather than assumed: the domain is distinct, and the category-ID space is completely disjoint from the siblings' (Grandin uses ids such as 11591 / 107755 / 217663 / 239154 / 59247; Frontgate uses 222xxx ids such as 222689 / 222683; Ballard uses 80905 / 162467 / 137446). Grandin has its own sitemap index (SiteMapIndex_v2.xml -> SiteMap_CAT_001-004_v2.xml, 253 category URLs, none shared with the sibling brands) and its own nav API, and no harvested product overlaps the sibling files. Extracted fresh and independently. CATEGORY TREE: taken from the site's own nav API https://www.grandinroad.com/JSONAPIs?module=categories (full tree with categoryId and targetURL, 253 nodes) and cross-checked against SiteMap_CAT_001-004_v2.xml (253 category URLs - the two sets agree, so no hidden branch was missed). COUNTS / RULE 1: every qty is numberOfProducts from https://www.grandinroad.com/UnbxdAPI?categoryId=<id>&returnRespAsJSON=true&isAPI=true&requesttype=ajax&rows=<n>&unbxdStart=<s> sent with header 'CBI-AJAX: 1' - the exact request the PLP React grid makes, so it is the rendered listing number and not a raw vendor total. The PLP HTML is a client-side shell that carries no SSR count, so per Rule 1 nothing was trusted on structure alone: all 11 leaf nodes were verified twice - (a) full paged enumeration at rows=100 collecting unique tile ids until exhaustion, which returned exactly numberOfProducts tiles and then stopped, and (b) a boundary test returning 1 tile at unbxdStart=N-1 and 0 tiles at unbxdStart=N. No divergence on any node. Several counts were additionally corroborated by the site's own multilevel category facet (e.g. Mirrors & Wall Clocks 16, Decorative Accents 63, Baskets 2) and Type facet. VARIANT-INFLATION CHECK (Rule 1): colour swatches do NOT inflate the count - 'Wooly Sheep' carries 3 colour swatches and occupies exactly 1 tile. Separately, the site deliberately splits some multi-style products into their own grid tiles that share a productId but carry distinct uniqueIds (<productId>_style1/_style2/_style3), distinct names, distinct PDP URLs and distinct prices; these are separate saleable items the site itself lists and counts as separate tiles, so uniqueId rather than productId is the correct product identity here. Affected nodes: Wall Decor & Art (108 tiles / 97 productIds), Indoor Lighting (73/68), Decorative Accents (63/60), Planters (55/51), Lawn & Garden Decor (59/58). RULE 0 GAINS: outdoor lighting was fully traversed and kept (Outdoor > Lighting, 22) instead of being dropped as an 'outdoor' node, and all mirrors were kept (Mirrors & Wall Clocks, 16) even though every one of them also sits inside Wall Decor & Art. RULE 0.6 OVERLAPS DOCUMENTED: (1) Decor > Lighting (11622, /indoor-decor/indoor-lighting/) and Rugs & Lighting > Indoor Lighting (239154, /area-rugs-door-mats/indoor-lighting/) have identical uniqueId sets (73/73) and the department facet on 11622 shows zero 'Decor' membership - the same listing under two URLs, emitted once at the canonical Rugs & Lighting URL. (2) Rugs & Lighting > Outdoor Lighting (239155, 21) is a strict subset of Outdoor > Lighting (59247, 22) - dropped, superset kept. (3) Easy Care Planters (190657, 15) is a pure material re-cut fully inside Planters (55) - dropped. (4) Mirrors & Wall Clocks (16) sits entirely inside Wall Decor & Art (108), and 5 plaques are shared between Mailboxes & Plaques and Lawn & Garden Decor - both pairs kept as genuine sibling nav branches with the overlap flagged; do not sum those rows. EXCLUDED BRANCHES: the entire Holiday & Gift scope per the brief - Christmas (categoryId 11552, 15 nodes), Halloween Haven (11551, 18 nodes), Seasonal / gifts-celebrations (11557, 21 nodes including Fall, Thanksgiving, Hanukkah, Valentine's, Easter and Patriotic decor and its own Entertaining node) and Gifts (251154, 6 nodes). Also excluded: the whole Furniture tree (11553, including every seating/dining/bedroom collection node), the whole Bedding tree (83163), all textiles (Decorative Pillows, Throw Blankets, Area Rugs, Outdoor Area Rugs, Door Mats, Outdoor Pillows, Outdoor Cushions & Pillows, Furniture Cushions and swatches), Indoor Greenery & Stems (151229), Faux Outdoor Greenery (116147) and Mini Urn Fillers & Topiaries (208705) as artificial plants, Outdoor Storage, Furniture Covers, Umbrellas, Fire Pits & Tables, and Outdoor Entertaining (259162 - only 4 items, of which 3 are an outdoor bar cabinet, an outdoor bar cart and a lawn game, so dropped as predominantly furniture/games rather than padded). Every 'Shop All' / 'New Arrivals' / 'Under $100' / 'Shop the Look' / 'Clearance' / 'Grand Finale Outlet' roll-up and price-band re-cut was never extracted per the brief (e.g. Shop All Outdoor Decor, 227157, numberOfProducts=570). SEASONAL LEAKAGE: per the assignment note, every mixed general-decor node was inspected title by title and cross-checked against the site's own department facet; the leakage is quantified in the per-row flags - heaviest on Entertaining & Serveware (~25 of 63), then Candles & Candleholders (~11 of 30), Wall Decor & Art (~11 of 108) and Outdoor Lighting (5 of 22).
